rationale: Calculated based on the provided protection case data. Zone 1 reach is set to 80% of the protected line impedance magnitude to ensure underreach. Zone 2 reach covers the full protected line plus 50% of the shortest remote backup line (L_BC). Zone 3 reach covers the full protected line plus 120% of the longest remote backup line (L_BD), which is verified to be below the load encroachment limit (80% of max load impedance). Delays are chosen within their respective coordination windows to ensure proper grading: Zone 1 is instantaneous, Zone 2 is set to 0.4s, and Zone 3 is set to 1.0s. All constraints are satisfied.
